title: NormalizedContent
description: A single piece of public content collected from a source, normalized to a common shape before storage.

source.description: Identifier of the originating data source, e.g. 'youtube'.

external_id.description: Unique identifier for this item within its source.

published_at.description: When the source published the item, if known.

region.description: Best-known geographic region associated with the item.

metrics.description: Engagement metrics as reported by the source. Unavailable metrics are null.

captured_at.description: When this collector run captured/observed the item.
